Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Meditron is planning to onboard three additional app projects under the existing account (MED-4532):

- Patient Intake Mobile (team: Intake)
- Clinical Summaries API (team: Clinical)
- Billing Reconciliation Batch (team: Finance)

High-level asks from your side: new API keys for each project, a short staging window for smoke testing, and an update to the monthly committed commit to cover the extra steady-state tokens during heavy ingest.

Proposed rollout (first pass):
1) Week of Mar 13 — provision three "staging" API keys and a sandbox tenant; redline SOW addendum for increased commit (attached draft).
2) Week of Mar 20 — integration smoke tests with Connor (SE) and your dev leads; we’ll provide a simple QA checklist.
3) Week of Mar 27 — promote to production keys; minor rate-limit tuning if needed.

Ben — I flagged potential capacity bumping; please weigh in on the recommended capacity profile below. Lauren — happy for you to own contract redline touchpoints with Procurement.

Attachments: Meditron_MA_plan_v3.pdf, SOW-addendum_MED-4532.docx (draft)

Next steps: Elena, if you can confirm the three project names and the start date for staging week (Mar 13 works for us), I’ll route the addendum for signature and schedule Connor for the integration runbook review.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Elena —

Thanks for the context. From a capacity perspective I recommend a small reserved burst overlay for the first 60 days after production promotion:

- Baseline: existing committed capacity + 20% token buffer (to cover predictable increase).
- Burst overlay: enable short, elastic capacity up to 2x baseline for throttle-free windows during payroll reconciliation jobs (Billing Reconciliation Batch).
- Quantization profile: keep Clinical Summaries on fp16/8-bit hybrid for latency-sensitive calls; Patient Intake can run on a cost-optimized int8 path.

This will require a short term delta in committed GPU hours; I'll attach a projected cost delta in the addendum. Connor, please confirm the staging play for KV cache seeding and prefix caching for the Clinical endpoints.

-Ben
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Elena / Team —

Quick technical checklist for the staging window (I'll walk this during the session):

1) Provisioning
   - Create three dedicated API keys scoped to project namespaces (we'll share key IDs in api-key-list.csv).
   - Sandbox tenant created with the same model version and quantization profile as prod.
2) Data & KV cache
   - Seed KV cache for Clinical Summaries using the representative prompt set (we need a small sample dataset — please share ~500 records).
3) Rate limits & quotas
   - Set staging rate-limits to mirror production but with lower concurrency caps.
4) Smoke tests (30-45 minutes)
   - Latency (p95) under 400ms for Clinical sample flows
   - Token accounting verification (sample invoices)
   - Failover test: simulate model variant fallback and verify app-level error handling
5) Rollback plan
   - If errors exceed threshold during production promotion we revert keys and pause ingestion for the affected project.

Attachments: api-key-list.csv (will be sent once keys are provisioned)

I can run the checklist with Elena's dev leads on Tue Mar 21 at 10:00 PT — does that time work?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
